[hr]

[size=5][color=#8BCB72][b]ABOUT THE MOD[/b][/color][/size]

Remember the original Fighting With NPCs mod? It was created by EduAnttunes and was originally released in 2020.

Unfortunately, the original version was marked as broken for Stardew Valley 1.6.

This project is an unofficial community update intended to bring the mod back for Stardew Valley 1.6.

This is not our original creation. We are maintaining an updated version of the original project and giving full credit to its original creator.

[hr]

[size=5][color=#8BCB72][b]WHAT IT DOES[/b][/color][/size]

Take a swing near [color=#E6B84A][b]Lewis, Pierre or Pam[/b][/color]. They'll talk big, and if you actually hit them, they get knocked out and sent to the Hospital.

[list]
[][color=#8BCB72][b]TRASH TALK[/b][/color] — 11 random taunts when you swing near them, plus Hospital dialogue.
[][color=#8BCB72][b]KNOCKOUT[/b][/color] — NPCs are knocked out and sent to the Hospital.
[][color=#8BCB72][b]LOOT[/b][/color] — Lewis drops Lucky Purple Shorts, Pierre drops Broken Glasses, and Pam drops Beer.
[][color=#8BCB72][b]REWARD[/b][/color] — +1,000g and a smug emote.
[][color=#8BCB72][b]CONSEQUENCE[/b][/color] — -250 friendship with the NPC you hit.
[][color=#8BCB72][b]SOUND[/b][/color] — Yes, there is a quack.
[/list]
[hr]

[size=5][color=#8BCB72][b]HOW TO PLAY[/b][/color][/size]

[list=1]
[]Equip a Scythe, Golden Scythe or Iridium Scythe.
[]Walk up to Lewis, Pierre or Pam.
[*]Swing with left click or C.
[/list]
[hr]

[size=5][color=#8BCB72][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/color][/size]

[list=1]
[]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] (4.0 or newer).
[]Download and unzip the mod.
[]Put the [font=Courier New]FightingWithNPCs[/font] folder into your Mods folder.
[]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
[/list]
[color=#E6B84A][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/color]

- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.0 or newer

[hr]

[size=5][color=#8BCB72][b]PLATFORM TESTING & COMPATIBILITY[/b][/color][/size]

[color=#8BCB72][b]TESTED AND CONFIRMED[/b][/color]

- Android
- Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3
- SMAPI 4.3.2.5

[color=#E6B84A][b]IMPORTANT COMPATIBILITY NOTICE[/b][/color]

This version has only been tested on Android.

We have NOT tested this release on PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, or any other platform.

Compatibility with those platforms has not been verified. We cannot guarantee that the mod will work outside the tested Android environment.

If you try it on another platform, please let us know how it goes through our Discord.

[size=5][color=#8BCB72][b]SUPPORT & TROUBLESHOOTING[/b][/color][/size]

Need help installing the mod? Having an issue? Does it fail to load on your PC?

We are willing to help investigate problems, even on platforms we have not personally tested.

[color=#E6B84A][b]IMPORTANT: DISCORD IS OUR ONLY SUPPORT CHANNEL.[/b][/color]

[url=https://discord.gg/D3n8fPPmZH][color=#78B9E8][b]JOIN THE DISCORD SERVER[/b][/color][/url]

If you need support, please join our Discord server and post your problem there.

When reporting an issue, please include:
[list]
[]Your platform (Android, PC, etc.).
[]Your Stardew Valley version.
[]Your SMAPI version.
[]Your SMAPI log or relevant error messages.
[*]A description of what happened.
[/list]
[color=#D97965][b]Please note:[/b][/color] We do not monitor or respond to support requests posted in Nexus Mods comments or GitHub comments. If you want us to see your issue and help troubleshoot it, you must contact us through Discord.

Support is provided on a best-effort basis. We cannot guarantee that every problem can be fixed.
